spec_match.rationale: The allowlist syntax, * default, sandbox interaction, and header patterns documented match the directive's spec framing.

interactive.rationale: Zero interactive controls — a table plus code blocks, which rule 7 does not accept for a concept page even as a reference.

blurb_alignment.rationale: It promises a reference and is one; the failure is against the site's interactivity bar, not the blurb.

edge_cases.rationale: Sandbox and default-value corners are documented in prose but nothing on the page proves them in this browser.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 5 pass / 1 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: loads cleanly with zero console errors; nothing to exercise.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, tabular reference styled per the system.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table and headings are fine, but with no controls the page offers nothing operable to verify.

openQuestions.title: Add a live directive probe to the reference
openQuestions.detail: document.featurePolicy.allowsFeature()/features() can prove in-page whether this browser knows the directive and what the effective allowlist is — a one-button probe would convert this static reference into a compliant concept page while keeping the tables.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: page renders its syntax tables and header patterns cleanly (zero console errors) but exposes no interactive surface at all — a static reference card on a feature whose policy state is probeable.
